That commit only adds the test to `tests/visual.test.ts`; no screenshot and no other file changed since the last review, and CI is green on the head.

Produced by Air Automations. Name: 2. Code Review / Run: https://air.jetbrains.cloud/org/05cf1a7f-6ab5-713b-abd3-29d0c8a05e2d/automations/8d0ab705-e1d8-4895-bf56-42b1c943eb46?run=0bc81903-1053-477a-b93f-5df3c1979c54

**suggestion** The spec's case "only `npm run e2e:update` writes one, and only on Linux" has no test: the guard can be removed and `npm test` stays green.
```
sed -i "s/if (updating && process.platform !== 'linux')/if (false)/" playwright.config.ts && npm test
gives:    pass 131, fail 0
expected: a failing test (AGENTS.md: integration tests for every case in the spec)
```
The guard itself works, checked with the platform faked:
```
echo "Object.defineProperty(process,'platform',{value:'darwin'})" > /tmp/darwin.cjs
NODE_OPTIONS="--require /tmp/darwin.cjs" npm run e2e:update
→ Error: Accept new screenshots on Linux, as CI runs them, not on darwin: see AGENTS.md
```
A test in `tests/visual.test.ts` can run exactly that (`playwright test --list -u` is enough: the config throws before any browser starts) and assert the exit code and the message.

Fixed in `7b2276c`: `tests/visual.test.ts` has a new test, *only npm run e2e:update writes a baseline, and only on Linux*. It runs `npm run e2e:update`'s command from `package.json` with `--list`, with Node preloaded to report `darwin`: it exits non-zero with `Accept new screenshots on Linux, as CI runs them, not on darwin: see AGENTS.md`, and so do `-u`, `--update-snapshots` and `--update-snapshots=all`. It also checks that `e2e:update` on Linux, and plain `playwright test` on a Mac, both list the tests. Your reproduction now fails:
```
sed -i "s/if (updating && process.platform !== 'linux')/if (false)/" playwright.config.ts && npm test
gives: pass 131, fail 1  (✖ only npm run e2e:update writes a baseline, and only on Linux …)
```
With the guard restored: pass 132, fail 0 (`npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm test`, in a clean environment with no token).
